title: Skirt Gifting Ceremony
description: Image credit: Sharon Rigby Skirt Gifting Ceremony – Stories Woven Through Fabric Sunday, November 30, 1:00 – 3:00 pm Start: Lower Hall Gallery | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Join us in concluding Stories Woven Through Fabric with a ceremony uniting Sharon Rigby’s ribbon skirts with the individuals whose stories influenced their creation. In Summer 2025, Sharon Rigby called out to the community, seeking Indigenous individuals who have been impacted by the Sixties scoop or residential school system who were willing to share their story. In response to each story, Rigby created a ribbon skirt. All are welcome to come listen, learn, and reflect within the warmth of this special community event. Admission is free and no RSVP is required. Content Notice Please be advised that this live event is unscripted. While every effort is made to foster respectful dialogue, the views expressed are those of the individuals and do not necessarily reflect those of the Aurora Cultural Centre. Some discussions may include mature themes or sensitive topics. Learn more about the exhibition →
